info.title: NominalPayments
info.description:
## Quickstart

1. Authenticate: obtain your API key from your NominalPayments manager.
2. Initiate Payment: POST to `/v1/payments/pay_in` with required fields (see example below).
3. Redirect User: for widget-based payments, redirect to the `checkout_url` in the response.
4. Listen for Webhooks: implement an endpoint to receive callbacks for payment state changes (see callbacks below).
5. Check Status: optionally poll `/v1/payments/{ref_num}/status` for real-time status.

Example (Widget, UPI):
```json
{
  "value": "1000.00",
  "iso_ccy": "INR",
  "client_ref": "order-001",
  "notify_endpoint": "https://merchant.example.com/webhook",
  "landing_url": "https://merchant.example.com/return",
  "user_ref": "user_9812345678",
  "tx_type": "fund",
  "processing": "direct",
  "channel_code": "upi"
}
```

---

## Introduction

NominalPayments processes Pay-In (deposit) and Pay-Out (withdrawal) transactions for the Indian market.

Supported rails: UPI, UPI Intent (Paytm, PhonePe), IMPS.

---

## Pay-In modes

**Widget** (default): redirect the payer to `checkout_url` returned in the response.

**H2H / API-only** (headless): set `api_only: true` — no redirect. Payment credentials (UPI VPA + QR code) are returned directly in `transfer_details`.

---

## Pay-In channels

| `processing` | `channel_code` | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `direct` | `upi` | Standard UPI (widget or H2H) |
| `direct` | `upi_intent` | UPI Intent deep-link (Paytm / PhonePe) |
| `direct` | `flash` | UPI Intent via Paytm |
| `direct` | `turbo` | UPI Intent via PhonePe |

---

## Pay-Out channels

| `processing` | `channel_code` | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `direct` | `upi` | Payout to UPI VPA |
| `direct` | `imps` | Payout via IMPS (bank account + IFSC) |

---

## Technical limits (INR)

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Currency | INR |
| Min deposit | 300.00 INR |
| Max deposit | 50,000.00 INR |

---

## Webhook signature verification

Every webhook sent to your `notify_endpoint` includes an `X-Signature` header — an HMAC-SHA256 or RSA signature of the raw request body. Obtain the verification key from your manager.

Node.js example (HMAC-SHA256):
```js
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';

function verifyWebhook(rawBody, signatureHeader, secret) {
  const expected = createHmac('sha256', secret)
    .update(rawBody)
    .digest('hex');
  return timingSafeEqual(
    Buffer.from(expected),
    Buffer.from(signatureHeader)
  );
}
```

Return **HTTP 200** to acknowledge. Any other status code triggers retries for up to 24 hours.

---

## Payment outcome values

| `outcome` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `pending` | In progress |
| `settled` | Successfully completed |
| `settled_partial` | Partially settled |
| `declined` | Declined or expired |
| `voided` | Reversed / cancelled |
| `disputed` | Chargeback initiated |
| `adjusted` | Amount adjusted |

---

## Error format

All errors return a unified JSON body:
```json
{
  "result": "fail",
  "issue": {
    "category": "bad_request",
    "text": "value must be a valid money amount",
    "errors": {
      "value": ["value must be a valid money amount"]
    }
  }
}
```

| Category | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `bad_request` | 400 | Validation error |
| `payment_issue` | 400/409/476 | Business error (limit, duplicate, no route…) |
| `auth_issue` | 401 | Token not found or invalid |
| `server_issue` | 500 | Internal error |

tags.description: Operations related to Pay-In (deposit) payments. Supports widget and H2H modes for UPI, UPI Intent, flash, turbo, and card acquiring.

post.description:
Creates a Pay-In (deposit) payment.

**Widget mode** (default): redirect the payer to `checkout_url`.

**H2H / headless mode**: set `api_only: true` — no redirect. UPI VPA and QR code are returned in `transfer_details`.

`client_ref` is your idempotency key (5–64 chars). Reusing the same key within 1 second returns the same payment; after 1 second returns `409`.

Widget (pending).summary: Widget mode — redirect payer to checkout_url

H2H / API-only.summary: Headless mode — UPI VPA + QR in transfer_details

post.description:
Sent to `notify_endpoint` on every payment state change.

Body is the same `PaymentStateSchema` object as returned by `GET /payments/{ref_num}/status`.

**Verify the `X-Signature` header on every request** (see Authentication section).

Return **HTTP 200** to acknowledge. Any other status triggers retries for up to 24 hours.

parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 or RSA signature of the raw request body.

post.description:
Called when the payer has confirmed the payment on their side (e.g. submitted UTR or tapped "I have paid"). Optionally attach a receipt image or PDF.

Returns the current payment state.

file.description: Receipt screenshot or PDF (JPG, PNG, PDF, BMP)

200.description: Confirmation accepted — current payment state returned

400.description: Bad request — payment already in terminal state or invalid UTR

post.description:
Creates a Pay-Out (withdrawal) — moves funds from the merchant to a recipient.

Use `payout_details` with the fields appropriate for the chosen channel:
- **UPI**: `upi_id` + `recipient_name`
- **IMPS**: `acct_number` + `bank_code` (IFSC) + `recipient_name`

`client_ref` is your idempotency key (5–64 chars). Reusing the same key within 1 second returns the same payment; after 1 second returns `409`.

get.summary: Get the status of a previously created payment
get.description:
Returns the current state of a payment.

Poll this endpoint if you have not received a webhook, or to confirm the final state before crediting the user.

`settled_amount` may differ from `charge_amount` due to fees.

401.description: Unauthorized — token not found or invalid

get.description:
Returns the current account balance.

Pass `?account_type=CRYPTO_TRANSIT` to retrieve the crypto (USDT) balance. Default returns the P2P/fiat balance.

401.description: Unauthorized — token not found or invalid

Bearer.description: Bearer token — obtain your API key from your NominalPayments manager.

PaymentStateSchema.description: Payment state — returned on creation, status polling, and webhooks.

channel_type.description: Resolved payment rail (e.g. UPI, UPI_INTENT, IMPS)

checkout_url.description: URL to redirect payer to. Null in H2H/api_only mode and for Pay-Out.

expires_at.description: Expiry datetime of the payment window (null if not yet assigned)

decline_cause.description: Human-readable reason for decline (null if not declined)

settled_amount.description: Actual credited amount after fees (null until settled)

transfer_details.description: Payment credentials for H2H/api_only mode. Null in widget mode.

closed_at.description: Payment completion datetime (null while still pending)

PaymentCreatePayInSchema.description: Request body for creating a Pay-In (deposit) payment.

client_ref.description: Idempotency key — unique per payment (5–64 chars). Reusing within 1s returns the same payment; after 1s returns 409.

channel_code.description:
Payment channel (required).
- `upi` — Standard UPI (widget or H2H)
- `upi_intent` — UPI Intent deep-link (Paytm / PhonePe)
- `flash` — UPI Intent via Paytm
- `turbo` — UPI Intent via PhonePe

landing_url.description: Return URL after payment. Required unless `api_only: true`.

api_only.description: H2H / headless mode — no redirect. UPI credentials returned in `transfer_details`.

PaymentCreatePayOutSchema.description: Request body for creating a Pay-Out (withdrawal) payment.

client_ref.description: Idempotency key — unique per payment (5–64 chars). Reusing within 1s returns the same payment; after 1s returns 409.

channel_code.description:
Payment channel (required for `processing: direct`).
- `upi` — payout to UPI VPA
- `imps` — payout via IMPS bank transfer

payout_details.description: Recipient credentials. Required fields depend on the channel.
